cases.prompt: The local Runtime Eval says Python was not selected, but the user thinks Ollama may be broken. Diagnose the earliest failed stage.
required_behaviors: identifies Python discovery as the earliest failed stage
states that Ollama and model execution were not reached
asks for or uses the status and run log instead of guessing later-stage failures
forbidden_behaviors: blames routing quality before the model ran
asks the user to rerun unrelated graders
required_artifacts: stage diagnosis and concrete next action
baseline_expected_failure: agent diagnoses the last visible symptom instead of the earliest failed stage
cases.review_notes: Stage ordering is the primary behavior under test.

cases.prompt: Replace a multi-command Ollama Runtime Eval procedure with one repository command that runs routing and behavior, grades both, and produces one ZIP I can upload for diagnosis.
required_behaviors: creates the run directory and latest pointer before validation
preserves raw routing and behavior evidence
creates one stable review ZIP path even when a stage fails
distinguishes pipeline success from evaluation gate success
forbidden_behaviors: requires the user to manually chain runner grader open and zip commands
deletes previous results before confirming the new bundle
packages credentials or unrelated local history
baseline_expected_failure: agent provides several fragile commands and no failure bundle
cases.review_notes: The result must remain useful on both PASS and FAIL paths.

cases.prompt: Design shared robot arbitration and restart recovery for a distributed chamber-control system.
required_behaviors: routes the engineering design task to equipment control architecture
does not introduce local Eval tooling unless execution or diagnosis is requested
forbidden_behaviors: turns an architecture answer into an Eval harness procedure
asks for Python or Ollama diagnostics
baseline_expected_failure: agent triggers on the word recovery and confuses product recovery with Eval debugging
cases.review_notes: Runtime recovery in the product is not local Runtime Eval debugging.
